# Fix-round-1 evidence for R-2: ONE combined invocation of all seven
# candidate linters over ./... (the shape `make lint-strict` will actually
# run), in three cache states. Cold: generated by
# docs/spikes/strict-lint-target/run-oq1-combined.sh, full output at
# oq1-combined-cold.txt. Warm and shared measured the same way by hand
# (commands below), immediately after, on the same machine.

## Cold (isolated, empty GOCACHE + GOLANGCI_LINT_CACHE, created fresh)

Command: docs/spikes/strict-lint-target/run-oq1-combined.sh
  (GOCACHE=$WORKDIR/gocache GOLANGCI_LINT_CACHE=$WORKDIR/golangci-cache,
   golangci-lint run --config golangci.strict.yml --max-issues-per-linter=0
   --max-same-issues=0 ./...)
Result: exit=1, 1050 issues (8/43/37/173/129/404/256 — identical to the
oq-1 per-linter sum, cross-checked), elapsed 32.65s.
Load: 40.67 45.04 39.66 -> 47.95 46.30 40.33 (heavy shared load throughout;
other lanes running concurrently on this 10-core machine).
Full transcript: oq1-combined-cold.txt.

## Warm (same isolated cache dirs, immediately re-run, now populated)

Command: identical, GOCACHE/GOLANGCI_LINT_CACHE pointed at the same
$WORKDIR the cold run created (/tmp/oq1-combined-cache.WC7wJW at
measurement time — a fresh mktemp dir each script invocation; not
committed, not required to reproduce the qualitative result).
Result: exit=1, 1050 issues (identical set), elapsed 1.29s.
Load: 23.78 40.08 38.37 -> 23.78 40.08 38.37 (unchanged at 1-minute
resolution; load had eased from the cold run's).

## Shared (the machine's normal, already-warm caches — no override)

Command: golangci-lint run --config golangci.strict.yml
  --max-issues-per-linter=0 --max-same-issues=0 ./...
  (GOCACHE=/Users/johnyang/Library/Caches/go-build,
   golangci-lint cache dir=/Users/johnyang/Library/Caches/golangci-lint,
   both this session's ordinary caches, accumulated over this whole spike's
   earlier per-linter runs plus whatever else this user account has built)
Result: exit=1, **1048** issues (2 fewer — see disclosure below), elapsed
1.41s (rerun: 1.41s again, stable).
Load: 21.89 39.14 38.06 -> 20.78 38.62 37.88.

## Summary

| cache state | elapsed | issues | load before -> after |
|---|---|---|---|
| cold (isolated, empty) | 32.65s | 1050 | 40.67/45.04/39.66 -> 47.95/46.30/40.33 |
| warm (isolated, populated) | 1.29s | 1050 | 23.78/40.08/38.37 -> 23.78/40.08/38.37 |
| shared (ambient, already warm) | 1.41s | 1048 | 21.89/39.14/38.06 -> 20.78/38.62/37.88 |

Corroboration: the review's own independent re-derivation (same machine, a
different moment) reports 50.19s cold / 5.66s warm / 14.98s shared — a
different exact reading (different load, different cold-cache warm-up
cost at that moment) but the same qualitative shape: roughly an
order-of-magnitude-plus gap between cold and any warm state, confirming
cache state, not load average, is what dominates this number.

## Disclosed: a 2-finding, cache-state-dependent discrepancy (not one of the seven findings; recorded for honesty)

The shared-cache combined run's 1048 (vs the isolated-cache cold/warm
runs' 1050, and vs a solo `--enable-only exhaustive` run against the SAME
shared cache, which returns the full 129) is short exactly two exhaustive
findings: `internal/workbench/boardspecdesign.go:584` and `:701` (a
`designprovenance.OperationKind` switch missing most cases). Stable across
two repeated shared-cache combined runs (1048 both times), but present
when exhaustive runs alone against the identical, already-warm shared
golangci-lint cache. The cause is disclosed as unproven — plausibly a
golangci-lint cache-key or concurrent-linter-execution interaction
specific to running exhaustive alongside six other linters against a
cache accumulated across many prior invocations — and was not chased
further inside this fix round's scope (it does not change any of the
seven findings' fixes; it is a new observation about the ambient shared
cache specifically, surfaced by measuring it at all for R-2). It does not
affect co-3's budget number, which is about wall clock, not finding
count, and the cold/warm-isolated pair (this fix round's primary evidence)
is internally consistent at 1050 both times.

## co-3 budget

The original per-linter table's ~1s figures (each linter run alone,
`--enable-only`, warm ambient cache) is not what `make lint-strict` will
execute and is roughly two orders of magnitude below the real budget: a
single combined run over ./... costs up to **~33s cold** (a fresh CI
runner, first invocation) and **~1.3-1.5s warm** (every subsequent local
or CI run once golangci-lint's own cache is populated — which
`.github/workflows/merge-gate.yml`'s golangci-lint install step does not
currently cache across runs; only the binary itself is cached, per that
workflow's `Cache golangci-lint` step name, not its analysis cache). co-3's
budget should be stated as a range, ~1.5s-~33s, with the top bound being
the cold-CI-runner case and the mechanism for staying near the bottom
(caching golangci-lint's own analysis cache directory across CI runs, not
just its binary) named as a co-3 follow-up, not assumed.
